label: copy phase: re-fed v/w/e/s input while emitting a letter like s/j/c/v/z/f
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (t > L), never on original inputs or the delimiter, and almost never at recall_idx 0-1. It is a token-conjunction unit: the fed-back input (the previous copied token) is mostly v, w, e or s (v/w hold ~55% of mass; t and u weaker), and the token being output now is one of a set of letters (s, j, c, v, z, f, w, e, then k, t, b, n). The strongest activations are at recall_idx 2 in short sequences (e.g. f w c <DEL> f [w]). It is weaker when the sequence has digits. It does not fire on first occurrences of tokens or on digit inputs. The input x output conjunction catches ~65% of active steps and ~73% of mass, but precision is only ~0.35: many matching steps stay below threshold, so magnitude depends on further context that was not captured.
